output.post:
Generic OCR breaks on layout variety. That is the core problem AP automation teams keep running into.

DocParse is a layout-aware document parsing API built specifically for invoices, receipts, and purchase orders. It extracts line items, totals, tax fields, and vendor data into structured JSON — with per-field confidence scores and a configurable human-review fallback for anything below your accuracy threshold.

On a published 5,000-invoice benchmark, DocParse reaches 99.2% field-level accuracy. p95 latency is 1.8 seconds per page, tracked on a public metrics page. SOC 2 Type I report is available under NDA; Type II audit is in progress.

Pricing is usage-based at $0.01 per page, with volume tiers and 500 free pages to start.

If your team is building an AP automation feature against an accuracy SLA and in-house OCR keeps missing it, DocParse is worth a look: {APP_URL}

output.alt_hook: An accuracy SLA is only as good as the pipeline behind it. Most OCR tools are not built for the layout variety that invoices, receipts, and purchase orders actually present.
